versions.name: Cub World

features.note: Four rental cabins plus a director's cabin, heated for winter use.
Six elevated platforms in the Mountain Man Village, each holding six tents.
Frisch's Dining Pavilion, with a kitchen and serving lines, plus activity shelters at the campsites.
Three shower houses, one near each sleeping area.
In the administration building and the director's cabin.

versions.summary: Cub Scout resident adventure camp at the Dan Beard Scout Reservation, adjacent to Camp Craig and Camp Friedlander.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/438-cubsummercamp); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
